about_the_game:
Modavuj Games presents.

Modavu Platformj is a multiplayer gift collecting competition that can be played with up to 4 players and an action game where players can throw colored gel balls.

Players can determine avatars with different visual features. They can determine the skin features, clothes, accessories and many additional features of their avatars.

Players try to reach the gifts in the platform area by trying to overcome many platform obstacles. In the meantime, they try to escape from the gel balls sent to them by the opponents generated by the game and the avatars used by real people. These gel balls reduce the player's energy and health and when this level is reset, the player becomes ineffective.

Players try to earn the highest score by collecting precious stones, footballs and different types of beautiful gifts.

Players can throw gel balls at each other and the characters created by the game and neutralize these opponents by reducing their energy.

Players can also fight together as a team by throwing gel balls only at the opponents generated by the game.

Players can also fight by grouping themselves or by throwing gel balls at each other.
